description: Chart 21 — Waffle unit chart: 100 boxes each = 1 percentage point of trips to a hospitality or social venue by main mode. VISTA 2022-23 + 2023-24 pooled, 2,378 surveyed trips. Each box is generated inline via a sequence transform — no CSV required. The layout is a 10x10 grid with 44 px horizontal steps and 34 px vertical steps, keeping the plotted height aligned with chart-19 while making the boxes wider. Five navy boxes (indices 94–98) are public transport (5.3% rounded to 5), sitting in the bottom row against a sea of grey (66 car boxes) and light-grey (28 walking boxes). The visual makes the 5-vs-66 asymmetry visceral rather than merely numerical. The proximity paradox hook ('yet 78% of venues sit within 400 m of a stop') is embedded in subtitle line 2. Data: VISTA, DTP Victoria, CC BY 4.0; derived by scripts/derive_hospitality_modes.py.
